Manipur Violence: Houses Torched in Naga-Kuki Clashes

Fresh violence erupted in Manipur's Kamjong district near the India-Myanmar border, resulting in over 20 houses being set ablaze. The clashes involved Naga and Kuki tribes, with reports indicating retaliatory attacks. Phaimol, a Kuki village, was reportedly torched, followed by suspected attacks on Tangkhul Naga villages. Security forces intervened after the damage occurred.
